name: swiftshelf-pos
description: SwiftShelf POS - Smart Mini Mart Point of Sale and Inventory Management (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
